title: Python: a listed non-factory class decorator is allowed only bare (@total_ordering(cls=X) refuses)
description: DEC-303 (a33) item 2, carried with the (a30) follow-up. A listed decorator that is NOT a decorator factory (functools.total_ordering, typing.final, typing.runtime_checkable, enum.unique) is allowed only BARE; a called form is allowed only for a listed FACTORY (dataclasses.dataclass), with keyword options only, under (a32) item 2's slots rule. #157 (GCLI-105) refuses a positional or ** splat argument to any listed decorator but still allows a KEYWORD argument, so @total_ordering(cls=X) still resolves and replaces the class. Fix: refuse any called form of a non-factory listed decorator; fixtures: @total_ordering(cls=X), @final(cls=X), @enum.unique(cls=E) refused at E1, N3 and 6d, with bare twins allowed and dataclass(frozen=True) still allowed; mutation-check the guard. Must land before the fresh blind sample (DEC-303 (a31) item 4). Carried with the staticmethod case of (a31) item 5 (GCLI-102, closed). Depends on #157 landing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a called form of total_ordering, final, runtime_checkable or unique refuses the class at E1, N3 and the constructor-bound 6d site, in the bin it had without the rule
the bare forms and dataclass called with keyword options other than slots still resolve
each guard has a mutation check that goes red
